description: Governance guardrails evaluated on every SDLC workflow run. A mandatory FAIL blocks downstream progression and release readiness (REQ-D-005). An EXCEPTION_REQUESTED outcome requires a human decision and is never granted by default (REQ-D-006).

rules.description: Redirect targets are restricted to an http/https scheme allowlist.
Targets resolving to loopback, link-local, RFC1918 or unique-local addresses are refused at create time.
API keys and other secrets are never written to logs or persisted in clear text.
No dependency carries a known vulnerability at CVSS 7.0 or above.
Audit rows are append-only and retained for at least the lifetime of the run.
Click analytics persist no personally identifying data.
Every dependency licence is inside the Apache-2.0 / MIT / BSD / EPL-2.0 allowlist.
An API contract change carries a semantic version bump and a recorded approval.
A change to an accepted architecture decision is recorded in an ADR.
A brownfield change is preceded by an approved impact analysis.
Tasks flagged tddRequired show a failing test run before the implementing change.
All mandatory tests executed in this run pass.
Contract tests were executed against the published API contract.
